Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Nemea Halolink. Character visual motifs: severe middle-aged maestro holding two tuning forks, no glowing permanent nearest-ally tether; performers are heard as positional *notes*.
TOP LEFT: Audible Interval. Ability concept: whenever two distinct allies finish spells **within 0.6â€“1.4 s of each other**, Nemea gains one Harmony note (max 3; one per pair / 8 s). No reward for simultaneous spam; notes are visibly displayed.
TOP RIGHT: First Note. Ability concept: creates a small 35-GU score circle lasting 3 s; the first ally entering receives one **shield-on-next-damage** token valid 2 s. Max two circles; a given ally benefits once per cast.
BOTTOM LEFT: Second Note. Ability concept: links **two separate score circles** with a luminous 130-GU-max segment. Allies *crossing the segment in either direction* gain 10% movement speed for 1.5 s, once per hero. Enemies can attack circles; the segment is not a tether on bodies.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Chorus Arrival. Ability concept: consumes Harmony to lay three successive public beat circles around the team over 3 s. Allies who voluntarily reach their assigned **different circles** on the announced beat receive a capped shield and brief recovery reduction, while clumping in one circle gives only minimal healing. Does not automatically shield the entire team in place.
